suggested_change: Clarify: (1) Scores 6+/10 require direct prospect quotes; if absent, cap at 5. (2) Pain must be prospect-articulated; budget constraints alone = 2/10 max. (3) Decision Process updates must justify why new call data doesn't warrant score adjustment. (4) Stage assessment must logically align with component scores—if Champion=1/10 and Competition=1/10, stage cannot be 'Decision Maker Bought In' regardless of other scores.
